description: The bidder reports that the VM's host cgroup crossed a memory threshold (memory.events high or max increased); sent as the payload of a market.event, edge-triggered and capped per contract.

kind.description: The cgroup threshold crossed: high (reclaim pressure) or max (the hard limit).

threshold.description: The threshold in bytes (memory.high or memory.max).

observed.description: memory.current in bytes when the crossing was seen.
